plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Brain Navigator reads your sleep, heart rate, and step data to fill in your daily check-in and reflect it on the Wellness Wheel.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Brain Navigator writes mindful minutes sessions to Health when you log them in the app.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Brain Navigator uses your location to show live weather and surf conditions on Today.

plugins.microphonePermission: Brain Navigator uses your microphone for the on-demand ambient noise check on the Health screen's Sleep Quality card.

plugins.photosPermission: Brain Navigator uses your photo library to attach a snapshot image to an entry.

plugins.microphonePermission: Brain Navigator uses your microphone so you can speak a vent entry instead of typing it.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Brain Navigator converts your spoken vent entry to text on-device.
